item.title: Seven countries now generate 100% of their electricity from renewable energy
item.description:
📝 Leer en EspañolSeven countries now generate nearly all of their electricity from renewable energy sources, according to newly compiled figures. Data from the International Energy Agency (IEA) and International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) also revealed that a further 40 countries generated at least 50 per cent of the electricity they consumed from renewable energy technologies in 2021 and 2022 – including 11 European countries. While Scotland’s electricity generation was dominated by wind power, researchers predict that solar will come to dominate global electricity supplies over the coming decades.
🔗 Read more: https://www.the-independent.com/tech/renewable-energy-solar-nepal-bhutan-iceland-b2533699.html
